# SECTION A: ENGINEERING, DESIGN & AI
================================================================================

## Executive Summary & Core Identity
Krzysztof Wancerski is an engineer and builder who turns ambiguous ideas into real things by combining software, design, and AI. He works across full-stack software, cross-platform mobile apps, AI-driven workflows, and physical hardware interfaces.

He holds a First-Class MEng in Design Engineering from Imperial College London, where he was awarded the Faculty of Engineering Dean's List for all four consecutive undergraduate years (recognising the top 10% of the cohort).

He enjoys problems where the path isn’t obvious yet. Rather than working from a predefined technology inward, he starts with the problem outward—determining what needs to exist and using software, AI, or physical systems to build it.

## Execution Range Across Disciplines
- **Design Engineering Foundations (Imperial College London)**: First-Class MEng (Dean's List all 4 consecutive years, top 10% of cohort). Trained across engineering, design, software, and physical product development, with a focus on turning human needs and technical constraints into working systems.
- **Smart-Home & Embedded Software (Tewke Ltd.)**: Designed and shipped cross-platform mobile apps and touchscreen embedded device interfaces in Flutter/Dart, bridging hardware telemetry with real users.
- **Software for Manufacturing Operations (Tewke Ltd.)**: Built full-stack tracking, automated parts deduction, and camera-assisted quality control used in the active production workflow for 1,000+ devices.
- **AI Workflows & Time-Series (AskForecast)**: Selected for a 20-minute oral presentation at the 44th International Symposium on Forecasting (ISF Montreal 2026) for an AI application making statistical time-series forecasting accessible.

## Selected Work & Systems
### 1. AskForecast — Natural-Language Time-Series Forecasting
- **URL**: https://askforecast.app
- **Classification**: Imperial Master's Project / Oral Presentation at ISF Montreal 2026
- **Headline**: Making complex statistical forecasting accessible through an AI-driven, natural-language workflow.
- **Overview**: An interactive web application where users upload datasets and describe forecasting goals in plain language. An LLM workflow interprets the prompt, automatically selects and executes statistical models, and presents forecasts with prediction intervals and clear explanations.
- **Highlights**:
  - **ISF Montreal 2026 Presentation**: Selected for a 20-minute oral presentation at the 44th International Symposium on Forecasting.
  - **Automated Model Selection Pipeline**: Built an LLM workflow that interprets natural-language requests, structures the problem, automatically selects and executes statistical forecasting models, and calculates prediction intervals.
- **Technologies**: LLM Workflows, Time-Series Forecasting, Model Selection, Python, FastAPI, Vue 3.

### 2. Yarn Health — Conversational Voice Journal for Chronic Illness
- **URL**: https://yarn.health
- **Classification**: Digital Health Product / 15 User Test Participants
- **Headline**: Turning everyday conversations and voice notes into structured summaries for chronic illness.
- **Overview**: A voice-first mobile application that allows users to speak naturally about their day, using AI to extract and structure conversational voice notes into longitudinal summaries that support more productive consultations.
- **Highlights**:
  - **Tested with 15 Participants**: Completed user testing with 15 people managing long-term conditions to refine speech interaction latency and ensure summary clarity for medical consultations.
  - **Streaming Voice Transcription & Extraction**: Implemented low-latency speech transcription with OpenAI Whisper alongside an extraction pipeline that organises longitudinal symptom patterns without burdening the user.
- **Technologies**: Flutter, Dart, Voice AI, Speech-to-Text (Whisper), Mobile UX, Health Data.

### 3. Smart-Home Mobile Apps & Embedded Touchscreen Interfaces (Tewke Ltd.)
- **Classification**: Hardware-Connected Software / Tewke Ltd.
- **Headline**: Bridging physical smart-home hardware and daily user interaction.
- **Overview**: A unified Flutter application running across iOS, Android, and embedded touchscreen Linux hardware, giving users direct, real-time control over their physical environment.
- **Highlights**:
  - **Unified Multi-Platform Architecture**: Built a unified Flutter application across iOS, Android, and embedded touchscreen hardware with real-time telemetry.
  - **Shipped to Real Users**: Owned interface features end-to-end through to production deployment on commercial smart-home hardware.
- **Technologies**: Flutter, Dart, iOS & Android, Embedded Linux, Device Telemetry, State Synchronization.

### 4. Software for Manufacturing Operations (Tewke Ltd.)
- **Classification**: Internal Operations & Tooling / 1,000+ Production Devices
- **Headline**: Full-stack operations software to scale physical hardware assembly.
- **Overview**: Full-stack internal operations platform managing multi-device production tracking, automated parts deduction, and camera-assisted quality inspections.
- **Highlights**:
  - **Used in Production Workflow for 1,000+ Devices**: Active core platform at Tewke Ltd., replacing previously manual tracking steps with automated inventory deduction and quality-control workflows.
  - **Automated Inspection & Workflow Engine**: Built custom camera-assisted quality checks at assembly checkpoints to catch build defects early.
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, Vue.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Docker, Operations Tooling.

## How I Work & Product Principles
- **Philosophy**: I work from the problem outward rather than from a predefined discipline inward. AI expands my execution range, while engineering discipline and problem definition lead the way. AI has made it easier to move between disciplines and iterate across a wider range of technical problems.
- **Core Tenets**:
  1. **Start with the problem**: Don't choose the technology before understanding what needs to exist.
  2. **Build things people can actually use**: A prototype is only the beginning; real-world behaviour and reliability matter.
  3. **Use AI to expand execution**: AI makes it possible to explore, prototype, and operate across a broader range of problems.

- **IET Future Talent Award**: Prestigious national engineering scholarship from the Institution of Engineering and Technology.

- **Let's Have a Coffee**: Based in West London. Open to talking through ambiguous problems, engineering systems, or early-stage product ideas over coffee in London or a call worldwide. Direct email: krzysztofwancerski@gmail.com | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kwancerski/

# SECTION B: ACADEMIC STEM TUTORING PRACTICE
================================================================================

## Practice Overview
- **Portal**: https://kwancerski.page/tutoring
- **Scope**: Bespoke 1:1 tuition for GCSE and A-Level candidates targeting top grades (A and A*) in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science. Over 4 years of proven experience helping students achieve their highest potential.
- **Location**: In-person across West London and online worldwide via Google Meet & Miro interactive whiteboard.
- **Enquiries**: Email krzysztofwancerski@gmail.com with the student's academic year, subject, exam board, and grade targets.

## Subjects Taught
- **Mathematics**: GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level Mathematics, Further Mathematics, STEP / MAT preparation.
- **Physics**: GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level Physics (Mechanics, Fields, Quantum, Thermodynamics).
- **Computer Science**: GCSE, A-Level Computer Science (Data Structures, Algorithms, Python, OOP).
- **University Admissions Mentorship**: Engineering and Computer Science personal statements and technical interviews for Imperial College London, Oxford, Cambridge, and Russell Group universities.

## Academic Credentials
- **Imperial College London MEng Design Engineering**.
- **4-Year Faculty Dean's List**: Recognised in the top 10% of engineering students at Imperial College London for four consecutive years.
- **4x A* at A-Level**: Perfect top grades achieved in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, and Design & Technology.
- **Imperial Teaching Assistant**: Hands-on teaching experience facilitating undergraduate engineering computing modules.

## Way of Working & Methodology
1. **Interactive Digital Whiteboard (Google Meet + Miro)**: Live mathematical derivations and physics problem sketches with permanent board revision notes for students.
2. **Focus on Top Grades (A & A*)**: Fast-paced progression past rote memorisation into first-principles problem-solving, exam mark scheme dissection, and non-routine question mastery.
3. **Structured Homework**: Targeted past-paper problem sets assigned each week with personalised feedback.
